---
name: task-done
description: Check that a task being implemented respect the definition of done. If not, make the necessary fixes until it respects it.
---

<what-to-do>

Take each line of the following definition of done, and check if the current modifications respect it.

* Automatic unitary tests have been added, and cover the modifications
* If relevant, integration and/or end to end tests have been added or updated, corresponding to the features that have been added or updated
* All tests pass
* Type hints and docstrings are up to date
* Linters has been applied
* No quality error
* The code added is of good quality
* Documentation has been updated accordingly

</what-to-do>
